notes.title: Free update out now!
notes.content:
CityDriver Free Update
Hey everyone!

We're happy to present a new update for CityDriver on all platforms! Check below for the Changelog!

Have fun driving!



[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-F2A7oVIeWs"][/dynamiclink]


Performance Improvements
Thanks to the update to a new version of Unreal Engine 5, we can take advantage of a new system that improves the game’s performance.
If you could previously only play on medium graphics settings, you'll now likely be able to play on higher settings.*

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42791338/eb78958e369005797e9f2d449ab0b0a9534b936f.jpg"]
Improved Lighting and Foliage
With the engine update, we’re using an enhanced lighting system that makes lighting situations in the game appear much more beautiful!
Foliage in trees and bushes also looks more realistic now. Look forward to an even more detailed and immersive depiction of Munich!*

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42791338/f3c7bb0389ac2ca8285877afefed60d165f7f97d.jpg"]
Day-Night Cycle
With the brand-new day-night cycle in the game, you can now explore the streets of Munich even in the dark!
Enjoy picturesque sunsets and take on the challenge of navigating the city's dark alleys.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42791338/88f49aa2eeebe7e34a08e1bbcd513b9ffa604865.jpg"]
Saved Mission Progress
Your mission progress is now saved! Play through all missions with top ratings and beat your own high scores.
With this update, you can track your achievements and aim for even better results.
Can you follow every traffic rule?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42791338/67156f05fab460733702a1139afa5737245eb0a8.jpg"]
Improved AI and Vehicle Physics
The AI of NPC vehicles has been improved to better follow traffic rules.
Vehicle physics have also been optimized, so you no longer spin out as easily after collisions.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42791338/178c835bc174ac8c43a75464ac82e8bb5b723324.jpg"]
Bug Fixes
Of course, this update also fixes several annoying bugs and potential crashes!



*Due to the many different PC systems and hardware configurations, improvements will vary in impact. Performance and graphical improvements will be most noticeable on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

notes.title: CityDriver | Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Update 1.0.1 is now live!

▶️ What's New
◽ Added the Vela GT vehicle

◽ Added Steam Achievements that can now be unlocked in-game

◽ Force Feedback has been expanded and improved.

◽ Added default button/axis mappings for the Logitech G920

◽ Radio stations "Flashbass.fm" and "Double Bass FM" have been added

◽ Modding
▫️the rotation direction of the vehicle wheels can now be inverted
▫️The wheel friction value can now be configured which is used during braking

▶️ Changes
◽ During transport missions, the parking options available in the vehicle are now displayed using a UI element when loading the packages

◽ There are now various force feedback customization options in the settings under "Advanced Controls".

◽ In the settings under "HUD and Gameplay" you can now adjust the wheel adhesion value of the vehicles to fine-tune the handling

◽ Brake and wheel grip values have been adjusted for all vehicles so that braking distances are now more realistic

◽ With the default key binding of the Logitech G29, the radio menu can now be closed with the same key that opened it

◽ Interiors of all vehicles have been brightened (only affects "High" and "Ultra" graphics presets)

◽ The warning lights on the dashboards of the vehicles are now always sharp

◽ The engine sound of the Alvarez-Lenz BPW C64 has been revised and improved

◽ The vehicle mirrors can now be adjusted so that they are displayed without stuttering (Warning: this setting reduces overall performance!)

◽ The rear camera views of the Alvarez-Lenz Marathon and Ferdinand Habanero Turbo have been improved

◽ After completing a quest, new quests are now offered even after a while

◽ The Alvarez-Lenz BPW C64 is now in Sport mode by default

◽ The appearance of Chrome materials has been revised

▶️ Bug Fixes
◽ The radio now also works correctly in mission vehicles

◽ Driving vehicles now works correctly even after abandoning missions

◽ The correct joystick button icons are now displayed for the Filters on the World Map

◽ Correct joystick axis icons are now displayed for World Map Zoom

◽ After changing a vehicle the radio now works correctly again

◽ Radio playback can now always be started correctly

◽ Collisions with pedestrians will now correctly reset, so the collision message will not reappear immediately after a collision

◽ Pedestrians are now not on the road at intersections while waiting

◽ When driving on the road, the speed limit display in the UI now works more reliably

◽ Pause menu navigation calculation now works more reliably so the game no longer crashes

◽ The Pedastrian Collision Message can now also be properly dismissed by pressing the "B" key on gamepads

◽ The Engine RPM Needle no longer appears twice on the Habanero Turbo

◽ The AI marathon transporter the turn signals now work correctly

◽ In the pause menu, the force feedback effects are now correctly stopped

notes.title: CityDriver | Price reduction
notes.content:
After gathering your important feedback, we have decided to introduce a permanent price reduction for all CityDriver products and, of course, offer a bonus to customers who purchased before 21th June. We are also happy to announce  the next DLC which will contain a map expansion as well as additional missions.
The price changes are as follows: 
- The Standard Version is permanently reduced from 34.95 € to 24.95 €. Everyone who bought the standard version before 21th June will receive the two vehicle DLCs for free. 
- The two vehicle DLCs are now available for 6.99 € instead of 8.95 €
- The next DLC will be available for 9.99 €. This DLC will be free for owners of the Deluxe Bundle. 
As we move forward in the development process, we will continue to focus on your important feedback and work especially on new features and improvements you would like to see the most.

notes.title: CityDriver | Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Update 1.0.1 ist now live!

▶️ What's New
◽ Force Feedback effect strength can now be adjusted up to a maximum of 2

◽ Resolutions larger than QHD (2560 x 1440) are now possible, but a higher resolution also significantly reduces performance

◽ The in-game time now advances from 06:00AM - 07:00PM (incl. correct change of the sun position)

◽ Added more key bindings for joysticks and steering wheels
▫️pause game
▫️open map
▫️photo mode
▫️light switch on/off
▫️light switch up
▫️light switch down
▫️fog lights on/off
▫️handbrake/"parking brake"
▫️hazard lights
▫️switch automatic/manual transmission
▫️switch driving modes
▫️center camera

▶️ Changes
◽ Adjusted the brightness in tunnels

◽ The area along Clemensstraße was decorated more

▶️ Bug Fixes
◽ Missing lights in Petueltunnel have been added

◽ The engine sound of the Volta Model E Performance is now audible again

◽ The license plate texture and traffic sign textures are now always displayed correctly

◽ The player vehicle (Volta Model Z) now works correctly after completing the tutorial

◽ The turn signals now switch off more reliably after cornering

◽ After switching from a car with a manual gearbox to a car with an automatic gearbox, the RPM display in the HUD is now hidden correctly

◽ The depiction of the Perfecta Figaro AI car model has been corrected so that the turn signals and brake lights can now be seen correctly again
